links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT neurosurgical patient information (Flesch-Kincaid) versus AANS patient webpages
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were more difficult to read (mean Flesch-Kincaid 32.4 ± 6.7) than AANS webpages (37.1 ± 7.0).
links.quote: ChatGPT responses were shorter (mean 270.1 ± 41.9 words; AANS webpage 1634.5 ± 891.3 words) but more difficult to read (mean Flesch-Kincaid score 32.4 ± 6.7; AANS webpage 37.1 ± 7.0).

links.outcome: Accuracy of references cited by ChatGPT in neurosurgical responses
links.effect: Of 177 references provided, 68.9% were inaccurate and 33.9% were completely falsified.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided 177 references, of which 68.9% were inaccurate and 33.9% were completely falsified.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to neurosurgical patient queries on readability, quality (DISCERN), and reference hallucinations compared to professional guidelines, but does not test a deployment practice or guardrail.
